name: codebase_read_file
description: Read one repository-relative text file. Returns path, content, truncated and total_chars. concise is the default and caps content at 4000 characters; detailed caps it at 20000. truncated=true means content is incomplete. Empty content means an existing empty file; a missing, excluded or non-text file is an error. Excludes config, node_modules and .git.

path.description: Repository-relative file path from a search result. Selects one file; do not supply an absolute path or invent a filename.

response_format.description: Choose concise by default to save context; detailed returns more code when the shorter result is insufficient.

examples.note: Typical: inspect a file returned by search using the cheaper content limit.
Hard case: request more content when a concise read was truncated. Preserve the exact path casing from search; detailed results may still be truncated at 20000 characters.
